protocol: FedBCert E21 staged identity-null structural correction
purpose: test graph utility after correcting E20's standalone spectral-classification objective mismatch

training_contract.stage_1: train only the graph-invariant feature expert and select its checkpoint by pooled validation Macro-F1
training_contract.stage_2: restore the selected stage-1 checkpoint, freeze the feature expert, and optimize only the identity-null residual with fused cross-entropy
training_contract.identity_control: same parameters and schedule with P=I, hence the structural residual is exactly zero

selection_rule.eligible_variants: one global nonzero alpha; no dataset-specific routing
selection_rule.objective: maximum mean observed-minus-identity validation Macro-F1 among feasible global alphas

confirmation_claims.primary_estimand: observed P minus identity P pooled test Macro-F1

fixed_hyperparameters.federated_optimizer: standard FedAvg weighted by labelled local training count

prohibited_actions: using seeds 103-105 before an E21a proceed decision
changing the staged objective or identity-null formula after viewing validation or confirmation metrics
dropping a dataset because observed P underperforms I
using confirmation test metrics for model or certificate selection
